explanation: Supergroup Rhizaria comprises foraminiferans (foramniferans) and radiolarians (radiolarens), which are characterized by fine, threadlike pseudopods and protective shells called tests. Foraminiferans possess multi-chambered tests composed of calcium carbonate, through which their pseudopods extend. Radiolarians possess glassy silicon tests featuring a radial arrangement of spines. Together, the accumulated tests of these organisms form layers of sedimentary material on the ocean floor. Fossilized foraminiferans serve as markers for different geological time periods.
